Wuji Description resource library

Upstream: https://github.com/wuji-technology/wuji-description
Revision: 829c9aa27cb12c3a49d5b8d63c9869dd8f656702

Includes the right Hand 2.2 MJCF and all of its mesh resources, plus the right
Hand 1 `body-with-soft/mjcf/right_simplified.xml` and its referenced meshes,
under the upstream MIT license. Both hands use the pinned revision above.
Install from the project root with `uv sync`. No runtime downloads or Git submodules.
